title: Import and Use the Standard Library
prompt: Import the math module and use math.sqrt() to compute the square root of 144. Store the result in a variable named root_val and print it.
hints: Add: import math at the top.
Call math.sqrt(144) and assign it to root_val.
explanation: import math loads the standard library math module, making math.sqrt() available.
starterCode: # Import math and compute the square root of 144
visibleTests:
assert 'math' in globals(), 'Import the math module'
assert root_val == 12.0, f'Expected 12.0, got {root_val}'

title: Import Specific Function With from ... import
prompt: Use 'from statistics import median' to import only the median function. Compute the median of [10, 40, 20, 50, 30] and store it in a variable named mid_val.
hints: Start with: from statistics import median
solution:
from statistics import median
mid_val = median([10, 40, 20, 50, 30])
print(mid_val)
explanation: from statistics import median binds median directly into your namespace so you can call it without a module prefix.
starterCode: # Import median from statistics and compute mid_val
visibleTests:
assert 'median' in globals(), 'Use from statistics import median'
assert mid_val == 30, f'Expected 30, got {mid_val}'
